name: job-posting-strategy
description: Complete job posting and distribution strategy for B2B SaaS companies — where to post by role (engineering, sales, marketing, CS, product, design), job board comparison, posting templates, sourcing channels, and expert recruiting strategies. References Betts Recruiting, SaaStr, YC, and Bridge Group data. Use when hiring for any role and determining where to find the best candidates. Triggers on: "job posting", "where to post jobs", "job boards", "recruiting strategy", "sourcing candidates".
